title: BST Rank and Selection
statement:
Implement a treap with subtree sizes to maintain a set of distinct integer keys.

Input
q, then q operations ADD x, ERASE x, RANK x, or KTH k. ADD and ERASE have set semantics. RANK counts keys strictly below x. KTH uses a 1-based rank.

Output
Print the answer for each query. Print NONE for an out-of-range KTH.

Constraints
1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. Keys have absolute value at most 10⁹ and 1 ≤ k ≤ q.

samples.input:
8
ADD 5
ADD -1
ADD 7
ADD 5
RANK 5
KTH 2
ERASE 5
KTH 3
